roleLine: Open Source Engineer · AOSP Developer · Linux Enthusiast
intro: I build things close to the system — from Android platform work and device bring-up to Linux tooling, automation and open-source infrastructure.
about: Most of my work lives somewhere between software and hardware. I enjoy taking unfamiliar systems apart, finding the layer that actually matters, and building something useful from it. AOSP, Linux, C/C++, device trees, CI and open-source communities are the areas I keep coming back to. I also care about technology as a way to create opportunity, especially for women entering technical fields.
quote: Code is not just what I write — it's how I solve problems and leave things better than I found them.

services.title: AOSP Development
services.description: Custom ROMs, device bring-up, system integration and Android platform work.

services.title: Linux & Systems
services.description: Shell scripting, tooling, debugging and exploring the layers underneath.

services.title: Open Source
services.description: Building, documenting and maintaining projects that others can use.

services.title: CI/CD & DevOps
services.description: GitHub Actions, build automation, workflows and reproducible systems.
